title: Crispy American Cheese Sandwich
description: A classic comfort food made with crispy bread and melted American cheese. Perfect for a quick snack or lunch.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place one bread slice, buttered side down, in the skillet.
Top with a slice of cheese, a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, and/or a few pickle slices (if using).
Place the second bread slice, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Carefully flip the sandwich over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Remove from heat and let cool for a minute or two before serving.
Cut the sandwich in half and serve hot.
